name: Nek'rosh's Gambit
summary: At Menethil Harbor, Captain Stoutfist braces for Nek'rosh's assault. The Dragonmaw chieftain has built catapults to batter the port, while fighting at Dun Algaz blocks reinforcements. You are sent into the marshes to destroy the engines before they reach the town.

sections.title: A Looming Siege
sections.body: Dwarven scouts uncovered the plan while Alliance fighters clashed with Dragonmaw raiders. Chieftain Nek'rosh has overseen the building of full-scale siege catapults in the Wetlands encampments. He means to bring them to Menethil Harbor and batter its fortress walls. The attack threatens the Alliance's main shipping hub on the western coast.

sections.title: Cut Off at Dun Algaz
sections.body: Fighting and greenskin activity clog the mountain passes at Dun Algaz. The lowlands are cut off from Ironforge's main garrisons, so Captain Stoutfist cannot spare troops to guard the harbor's perimeter. Without aid from Khaz Modan, Menethil's survival depends on sabotaging the catapults before they can be brought against the town.

sections.title: Fire in the Encampment
sections.body: Scouts carry Dwarven Tinder into the heart of the Dragonmaw encampment. There, they must set the timber catapults ablaze and destroy them. This will strip Nek'rosh of his artillery and deny his warriors the firepower to break Menethil's defenses. The engines must be ruined before the warlord can be confronted.

faq.answer: Nek'rosh leads the remnants of the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands. The ruthless chieftain is directing a campaign to besiege Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: Why is Menethil Harbor in such danger?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor depends on naval trade and lies apart from Ironforge. Fighting clogs the passes at Dun Algaz, blocking land reinforcements and leaving the town unable to withstand a concentrated siege.

faq.q: What is the goal of this mission?
faq.answer: You carry Dwarven Tinder into the Dragonmaw encampment to burn and destroy their siege catapults before they can be brought against Menethil Harbor.
Captain Stoutfist gives the orders. The dwarf officer coordinates the harbor's local defense and the campaign against the Dragonmaw.

faq.q: What follows the destruction of the catapults?
faq.answer: Once the catapults are destroyed, the threat must be ended by tracking down and executing Chieftain Nek'rosh himself.

faq.q: Why can't Ironforge send troops to help Menethil?
faq.answer: The road from Loch Modan to the Wetlands runs through Dun Algaz. Hostile forces contest and ambush the pass, cutting off reliable travel by land.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard dwarf, you know Menethil Harbor is your people's gateway to the western sea. Losing it to Dragonmaw siege weapons would cripple Ironforge's maritime connections.
With fighting locking down Dun Algaz, the Alliance depends on brave volunteers to disrupt the Dragonmaw war machine.
As a warrior, you rely on aggressive frontline tactics and brutal hand-to-hand fighting to storm an entrenched enemy camp and destroy its heavy siege artillery.
